title: Software Engineer II
description:
## About Example Fintech Co

Example Fintech Co is a fictional company used for synthetic test data. We build payments infrastructure for customers across many industries.

## The role: Software Engineer II

You will design, build and operate production services with a small, collaborative team.

## What you'll do

- Own features end to end, from design review to rollout
- Harden the payments ledger service
- Improve observability, testing and deployment tooling
- Mentor teammates and review code

## What we're looking for

- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong Python or Go skills and experience with distributed systems
- Familiarity with PostgreSQL, Docker and a major cloud provider

## Benefits

Health coverage, a learning budget and flexible hours.
